narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligated $2.1B in FY2026 to date. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies received 1 award so far this fiscal year, and the average award size is $2.1B. Obligations are up 0.3% year over year. Historical obligations show some stability: FY21 obligations were $1.7B, FY22 obligations were $2B, FY23 obligations were $1.8B, FY24 obligations were $1.8B, and FY25 obligations were $2.1B. The note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except where tables list award values, and current-year totals are partial. This snapshot emphasizes that a single large award accounts for the FY2026 to date total, and that annual obligations have ranged between $1.7B and $2.1B over the past six fiscal years.
